item.mod-stella-spells.spark_shot.desc: Hits your target for 3 magic damage and burns it for 6 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.spark_shot.desc_l: Hits your target for %1$s magic damage and burns it for %5$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.frostbind.desc: Slowness II on your target for 8 seconds, plus a Chill. A fourth Chill freezes it solid.
item.mod-stella-spells.frostbind.desc_li: Slowness %8$s on your target for %4$s, plus a Chill. A fourth Chill freezes it solid.
item.mod-stella-spells.gale_step.desc: Launches you forward on a gust, then Slow Falling for 2 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.gale_step.desc_li: Launches you forward on a gust, then Slow Falling for %4$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.stoneguard.desc: Hardens your skin with Resistance I for 30 minutes.
item.mod-stella-spells.stoneguard.desc_l: Hardens your skin with Resistance %8$s for %4$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.static_lash.desc: Shocks your target for 3 damage, then arcs 3 damage to up to 2 more hostiles within 4 blocks. Soaked mobs take half again as much.
item.mod-stella-spells.static_lash.desc_: Shocks your target for %1$s damage, then arcs %1$s damage to up to %7$s more hostiles within %6$s blocks. Soaked mobs take half again as much.
item.mod-stella-spells.briar_snare.desc: Roots your target in thorns with Slowness IV for 8 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.briar_snare.desc_: Roots your target in thorns with Slowness %8$s for %4$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.tidal_push.desc: Knocks your target away with a wave and leaves it Soaked.
item.mod-stella-spells.slimebound.desc: Jump Boost II and Slow Falling for 30 minutes.
item.mod-stella-spells.slimebound.desc_l: Jump Boost %8$s and Slow Falling for %4$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.chainstorm.desc: Lightning strikes up to 5 hostiles within 5 blocks of the spot you look at, 6 damage each. Soaked mobs take half again as much.
item.mod-stella-spells.chainstorm.desc_l: Lightning strikes up to %7$s hostiles within %6$s blocks of the spot you look at, %1$s damage each. Soaked mobs take half again as much.
item.mod-stella-spells.riftwalk.desc: Teleports you to the spot you look at, or in front of the wall you look at. Never into walls, water or mobs.
item.mod-stella-spells.phoenix_mantle.de: Fire Resistance for 30 minutes and heals you for 4 health.
Fire Resistance for %4$s and heals you for %2$s health.
item.mod-stella-spells.life_bloom.desc: Heals you for 8 health and gives Regeneration I for 15 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.life_bloom.desc_l: Heals you for %2$s health and gives Regeneration %8$s for %4$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.void_well.desc: Pulls every hostile within 5 blocks of the spot toward it, with Slowness II for 6 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.void_well.desc_li: Pulls every hostile within %6$s blocks of the spot toward it, with Slowness %8$s for %4$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.wardens_roar.desc: Deals 6 damage to every hostile within 5 blocks and throws them back.
Deals %1$s damage to every hostile within %6$s blocks and throws them back.
item.mod-stella-spells.aegis_of_the_deep: Absorption II and Resistance I for 30 minutes.
item.mod-stella-spells.wither_seal.desc: Wither II on your target for 15 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.time_lock.desc: Slowness II for 10 seconds on every hostile within 5 blocks of the spot.
item.mod-stella-spells.time_lock.desc_li: Slowness %8$s for %4$s on every hostile within %6$s blocks of the spot.
item.mod-stella-spells.dragonfall.desc: A huge burning fire charge lands on the spot, dealing 10 magic damage to every hostile within 3 blocks.
item.mod-stella-spells.dragonfall.desc_l: A huge burning fire charge lands on the spot, dealing %1$s magic damage to every hostile within %6$s blocks.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.scroll: Single use: the scroll crumbles when the spell lands
item.mod-stella-spells.ice_lance.desc: A lance of ice pierces your target and flies on for 16 blocks. Every hostile on its line takes 5 damage and freezes solid for 14 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.ice_lance.desc_li: A lance of ice pierces your target and flies on for %6$s blocks. Every hostile on its line takes %1$s damage and freezes solid for %4$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.soul_siphon.desc: Drains 4 health from your target and gives it to you.
item.mod-stella-spells.soul_siphon.desc_: Drains %1$s health from your target and gives it to you.
item.mod-stella-spells.venom_dart.desc: Stings your target for 2 damage and gives Poison II for 15 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.venom_dart.desc_l: Stings your target for %1$s damage and gives Poison %8$s for %4$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.sapping_hex.desc: Weakness II on every hostile within 6 blocks, and Strength II on you: 9 seconds for each hostile hexed, up to 45 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.sapping_hex.desc_: Weakness %8$s on every hostile within %6$s blocks, and Strength %9$s on you: %4$s for each hostile hexed, up to %5$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.blinding_flash.de: Blinds your target for 15 seconds and Marks it for 30 seconds: it glows and takes more damage from players.
Blinds your target for %4$s and Marks it for %5$s: it glows and takes more damage from players.
item.mod-stella-spells.ember_brand.desc: Brands your target for 2 damage, burns it for 30 seconds, and Scorches it so it heals half as much. A Soaked mob only dries off.
item.mod-stella-spells.ember_brand.desc_: Brands your target for %1$s damage, burns it for %4$s, and Scorches it so it heals half as much. A Soaked mob only dries off.
item.mod-stella-spells.tide_lungs.desc: Breathe underwater for 30 minutes and swim fast for 30 minutes.
item.mod-stella-spells.tide_lungs.desc_l: Breathe underwater for %4$s and swim fast for %5$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.shadow_veil.desc: Invisible for 30 minutes. Your first blow breaks the veil: it deals double damage and stops its victim dead for 2 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.shadow_veil.desc_: Invisible for %4$s. Your first blow breaks the veil: it deals double damage and stops its victim dead for %5$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.sanctuary.desc: Holy zone of 6 blocks where you stand for 30 seconds: players in it regenerate, and undead in it take 3 damage every second.
item.mod-stella-spells.sanctuary.desc_li: Holy zone of %6$s blocks where you stand for %4$s: players in it regenerate, and undead in it take %1$s damage every second.
item.mod-stella-spells.purify.desc: Clears every harmful effect from you and each player within 6 blocks.
item.mod-stella-spells.purify.desc_live: Clears every harmful effect from you and each player within %6$s blocks.
item.mod-stella-spells.frost_nova.desc: Deals 3 damage to hostiles within 5 blocks, with Slowness IV for 6 seconds and a Chill.
item.mod-stella-spells.frost_nova.desc_l: Deals %1$s damage to hostiles within %6$s blocks, with Slowness %8$s for %4$s and a Chill.
item.mod-stella-spells.earthspike.desc: Throws hostiles within 3 blocks of the spot into the air for 4 damage.
item.mod-stella-spells.earthspike.desc_l: Throws hostiles within %6$s blocks of the spot into the air for %1$s damage.
item.mod-stella-spells.plague_cloud.desc: A cloud of Poison lingers at the spot for 15 seconds.
A cloud of Poison lingers at the spot for %4$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.flame_ring.desc: Burning aura for 5 minutes: each second, hostiles within 5 blocks take 3 damage and catch fire. You never burn.
item.mod-stella-spells.flame_ring.desc_l: Burning aura for %4$s: each second, hostiles within %6$s blocks take %1$s damage and catch fire. You never burn.
item.mod-stella-spells.return_scroll.des: Read it to return to your respawn point in the Overworld.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.fizzle: Your head spins and the spell fizzles.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.needs_offhan: Spell Writer needs a spellbook in your off hand.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.no_scroll: That spellbook has no scroll to write.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.needs_staff: Soul Vulcan needs a staff in your main hand. Cast it from your off hand.
item.mod-stella-spells.scroll_book.desc: Holds 9 different scrolls. Use it to open.
item.mod-stella-spells.compendium.desc: Casts every spell and skill stored in it at once. Imbue it with a spell book or skill book at an anvil. It stores many.
item.mod-stella-spells.gravity.desc: Hostiles within 6 blocks are slowed and can jump only half as high for 16 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.gravity.desc_live: Hostiles within %6$s blocks are slowed and can jump only half as high for %4$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.bulwark_hymn.desc: Absorption II for 30 minutes on you and every ally within 8 blocks: players, villagers, golems and tamed pets.
Absorption %8$s for %4$s on you and every ally within %6$s blocks: players, villagers, golems and tamed pets.
item.mod-stella-spells.tailwind.desc: Speed II for 30 minutes on you and every ally within 8 blocks.
item.mod-stella-spells.tailwind.desc_liv: Speed %8$s for %4$s on you and every ally within %6$s blocks.
item.mod-stella-spells.battle_hymn.desc: Strength I for 30 minutes on you and every ally within 8 blocks.
item.mod-stella-spells.battle_hymn.desc_: Strength %8$s for %4$s on you and every ally within %6$s blocks.
item.mod-stella-spells.summon_skeleton.d: Raises a skeleton that serves you. Cast again to call it to your side. Use it to open its gear.
item.mod-stella-spells.memorize.desc: The next 10 fully charged staff attacks that hit trigger every imbued spell of your staff.
item.mod-stella-spells.memorize.desc_liv: The next %7$s fully charged staff attacks that hit trigger every imbued spell of your staff.
item.mod-stella-spells.soul_vulcan.desc: For 1 minute, each staff attack also fires 5 homing bolts at the target and the foes around it. Each bolt can trigger imbued spells.
item.mod-stella-spells.soul_vulcan.desc_: For %4$s, each staff attack also fires %7$s homing bolts at the target and the foes around it. Each bolt can trigger imbued spells.
item.mod-stella-spells.spell_writer.desc: Writes 32 scrolls of the spellbook in your off hand.
Writes %7$s scrolls of the spellbook in your off hand.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.awaken.no_pl: Only a player can awaken a spellbook.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.awaken.no_bo: Hold a spellbook in your main hand.
item.mod-stella-spells.cleave.desc: Hits every hostile in a 120 degree arc within 4 blocks for 4 physical damage and makes it bleed for 15 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.cleave.desc_live: Hits every hostile in a 120 degree arc within %6$s blocks for %1$s physical damage and makes it bleed for %4$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.leap_slam.desc: Leaps to your target and hits every hostile within 3 blocks of the landing for 3 physical damage.
item.mod-stella-spells.leap_slam.desc_li: Leaps to your target and hits every hostile within %6$s blocks of the landing for %1$s physical damage.
item.mod-stella-spells.whirlwind.desc: Spins 3 times, 1 second apart, hitting every hostile within 3 blocks for 2 physical damage a spin.
item.mod-stella-spells.whirlwind.desc_li: Spins 3 times, %4$s apart, hitting every hostile within %6$s blocks for %1$s physical damage a spin.
item.mod-stella-spells.shield_bash.desc: Hits your target for 2 physical damage and staggers it for 2 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.shield_bash.desc_: Hits your target for %1$s physical damage and staggers it for %4$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.charge.desc: Charges up to 8 blocks forward and hits every hostile on the way for 2 physical damage.
item.mod-stella-spells.charge.desc_live: Charges up to 8 blocks forward and hits every hostile on the way for %1$s physical damage.
item.mod-stella-spells.execute.desc: Hits your target for 6 physical damage: 3 times as much under 30 percent health, and twice as much again while it bleeds.
item.mod-stella-spells.execute.desc_live: Hits your target for %1$s physical damage: 3 times as much under 30 percent health, and twice as much again while it bleeds.
item.mod-stella-spells.war_cry.desc: Every hostile within 8 blocks attacks you. You gain Resistance I for 10 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.war_cry.desc_live: Every hostile within %6$s blocks attacks you. You gain Resistance %8$s for %4$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.counter_stance.de: For 1.5 seconds the first melee hit on you is turned aside, and the attacker takes 4 physical damage and is staggered for 2 seconds.
For %4$s the first melee hit on you is turned aside, and the attacker takes %1$s physical damage and is staggered for %5$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.iron_skin.desc: Gives you Resistance I for 30 minutes.
item.mod-stella-spells.earthsplitter.des: Breaks the ground in an 8 block line ahead and hits every hostile on it for 3 physical damage.
Breaks the ground in an %6$s block line ahead and hits every hostile on it for %1$s physical damage.
item.mod-stella-spells.vultures_eye.desc: For 30 minutes, arrow and archer skill hits gain 2%% damage per block beyond 8, up to 40%% (60%% when awakened).
For %4$s, arrow and archer skill hits gain 2%% damage per block beyond 8, up to 40%% (60%% when awakened).
item.mod-stella-spells.summon_wolf.desc: Tames a wolf that follows and guards you. Its aura: Speed and Strength for allies, Slowness and Weakness for hostiles. Right-click to ride it.
item.mod-stella-spells.arrow_crafting.de: Turns one arrow material into 32 arrows of its kind (48 when awakened). Takes it from your off hand first, else your pack.
item.mod-stella-spells.quiver.desc: Right-click to fill its nine slots with arrows and fireworks. In your off hand, a bow or crossbow draws from it first, and archer skills spend its arrows.
item.mod-stella-spells.flint_arrow.desc: Hits 20 percent harder than a plain arrow.
item.mod-stella-spells.iron_arrow.desc: Hits 40 percent harder than a plain arrow.
item.mod-stella-spells.diamond_arrow.des: Hits 75 percent harder than a plain arrow and pierces one extra foe.
item.mod-stella-spells.keen_arrow.desc: Hits 15 percent harder than a plain arrow and is always a critical arrow.
item.mod-stella-spells.fire_arrow.desc: Sets the target on fire for 4 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.frost_arrow.desc: Slows the target (Slowness II) for 3 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.venom_arrow.desc: Poisons the target (Poison I) for 4 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.blast_arrow.desc: Bursts for 3 damage on every hostile within 2 blocks of the hit, except the foe it struck. Breaks no block.
item.mod-stella-spells.multishot.desc: Looses one arrow up to 24 blocks and arrives where it lands. A wall stops both.
item.mod-stella-spells.multishot.desc_li: Looses one arrow up to %6$s blocks and arrives where it lands. A wall stops both.
item.mod-stella-spells.piercing_shot.des: Pierces every hostile on a 24 block line for 4 physical damage, +30%% critical chance. Needs no arrow.
Pierces every hostile on a %6$s block line for %1$s physical damage, +30%% critical chance. Needs no arrow.
item.mod-stella-spells.arrow_rain.desc: Looses 64 arrows (128 awakened) over 4 seconds from behind you onto a 3 by 3 area. Each hit deals your average ranged roll and slows.
item.mod-stella-spells.arrow_rain.desc_l: Looses 64 arrows (128 awakened) over 4 seconds from behind you onto a 3 by 3 area. Each hit deals your average ranged roll and slows.
item.mod-stella-spells.rapid_fire.desc: Shoots your target twice at once, 2 physical damage a hit. Needs no arrow.
item.mod-stella-spells.rapid_fire.desc_l: Shoots your target twice at once, %1$s physical damage a hit. Needs no arrow.
item.mod-stella-spells.ankle_snare.desc: Lays a trap on the ground you look at for 30 seconds. The first hostile within 1.5 blocks is rooted for 3 seconds. Needs no arrow.
item.mod-stella-spells.ankle_snare.desc_: Lays a trap on the ground you look at for %5$s. The first hostile within %6$s blocks is rooted for %4$s. Needs no arrow.
item.mod-stella-spells.arrow_repel.desc: One heavy shot at your target: 3 physical damage and knockback several blocks. Needs no arrow.
item.mod-stella-spells.arrow_repel.desc_: One heavy shot at your target: %1$s physical damage and knockback several blocks. Needs no arrow.
item.mod-stella-spells.hunters_mark.desc: Falcon for 30 minutes. 25%% per blow or arrow (35%% with a bow): 3 strikes (6 with a bow). Idle 2 s: 3 hits per 1.5 s at a hostile within 8 blocks.
Falcon for %4$s. 25%% per blow or arrow (35%% with a bow): 3 strikes (6 with a bow). Idle 2 s: 3 hits per 1.5 s at a hostile within 8 blocks.
item.mod-stella-spells.explosive_arrow.d: Your next arrow bursts for 1.5 times its damage and hits every hostile within 3 blocks for 2 more, breaking no block. Waits 30 seconds.
Your next arrow bursts for 1.5 times its damage and hits every hostile within %6$s blocks for 2 more, breaking no block. Waits %4$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.disengage.desc: Walk a quarter faster for 30 minutes.
item.mod-stella-spells.snare_trap.desc: 30 minutes with a bow or crossbow in hand: +25 Dexterity, +50%% critical chance, +0.5 critical multiplier. Needs the RPG mod.
item.mod-stella-spells.snare_trap.desc_l: %4$s with a bow or crossbow in hand: +25 Dexterity, +50%% critical chance, +0.5 critical multiplier. Needs the RPG mod.
item.mod-stella-spells.aimed_bolt.desc: Next arrow: draws half again as slowly, 4 times the damage, stops its target 2 seconds. Waits 30 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.aimed_bolt.desc_l: Next arrow: draws half again as slowly, 4 times the damage, stops its target %5$s. Waits %4$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.triangle_shot.des: Each shot has a 30%% chance to loose three arrows instead of one, for 30 minutes.
Each shot has a 30%% chance to loose three arrows instead of one, for %4$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.eagle_eye.desc: For 30 minutes, archer skill hits deal 1.2 times their damage, and your critical chance rises 15%% while you hold a bow.
item.mod-stella-spells.eagle_eye.desc_li: For %4$s, archer skill hits deal 1.2 times their damage, and your critical chance rises 15%% while you hold a bow.
Fire with no arrow for 30 minutes. A carried arrow is spent first. Every hit deals three quarters of its damage.
Fire with no arrow for %4$s. A carried arrow is spent first. Every hit deals three quarters of its damage.
item.mod-stella-spells.holy_light.desc: Heals your target ally for 6 health, or you when no ally is in reach.
item.mod-stella-spells.holy_light.desc_l: Heals your target ally for %2$s health, or you when no ally is in reach.
item.mod-stella-spells.prayer_of_mending: Heals your target ally for 3 health, then bounces to the most wounded ally within 8 blocks 4 times, 10 ticks apart.
Heals your target ally for %2$s health, then bounces to the most wounded ally within 8 blocks 4 times, 10 ticks apart.
item.mod-stella-spells.renew.desc: Heals your target ally for 1 health every 40 ticks for 30 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.renew.desc_live: Heals your target ally for %2$s health every 40 ticks for %4$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.divine_shield.des: Gives your target ally an arcane ward of 8 health for 30 seconds.
Gives your target ally an arcane ward of %3$s health for %4$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.holy_arms.desc: Your side's melee, arrow and spell hits within 8 blocks deal 1 bonus holy damage, twice against undead, for 30 minutes.
item.mod-stella-spells.holy_arms.desc_li: Your side's melee, arrow and spell hits within %6$s blocks deal %1$s bonus holy damage, twice against undead, for %4$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.blessing_of_forti: Health Boost II for 30 minutes on you and allies within 8 blocks.
Health Boost %8$s for %4$s on you and allies within %6$s blocks.
item.mod-stella-spells.smite.desc: Strikes your target for 4 holy damage, twice against undead.
item.mod-stella-spells.smite.desc_live: Strikes your target for %1$s holy damage, twice against undead.
item.mod-stella-spells.resurrection_ward: Wards your target ally for 5 minutes. The first lethal hit leaves it at 30 percent health.
Wards your target ally for %4$s. The first lethal hit leaves it at 30 percent health.
item.mod-stella-spells.consecrate.desc: Holy ground of radius 4 for 30 seconds. Every 20 ticks allies heal 1 and undead take 2 holy damage.
item.mod-stella-spells.consecrate.desc_l: Holy ground of radius %6$s for %4$s. Every 20 ticks allies heal %2$s and undead take %1$s holy damage.
item.mod-stella-spells.guardian_angel.de: Links your target ally for 30 seconds. 30 percent of each hit on it goes to you instead.
Links your target ally for %4$s. 30 percent of each hit on it goes to you instead.
item.mod-stella-spells.unbroken_vow.desc: For 30 minutes your equipment loses 1 durability per 1 + Vitality + Intelligence points of wear. Needs the RPG mod.
For %4$s your equipment loses 1 durability per 1 + Vitality + Intelligence points of wear. Needs the RPG mod.
For 20 seconds no harmful status lands on you, and every blow you deal is worth a tenth.
For %4$s no harmful status lands on you, and every blow you deal is worth a tenth.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.refine.resis: -%s%% damage taken while the guard lasts
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.refine.matk: +%s%% MATK for %s seconds after a cast
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.refine.m10.f: +10: foes it hits burn for 4 seconds
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.refine.m10.s: +10: foes it hits get Slowness II for 3 seconds
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.sig.spark_sh: Arcs to 2 foes within 5 blocks of the target. Each takes half the hit and burns 4 seconds.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.sig.frostbin: Freezes the target solid for 2 seconds. Foes within 4 blocks gain a Chill.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.sig.gale_ste: Gives Speed II for 5 seconds. Foes within 4 blocks of your start are thrown back.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.sig.mending_: Heals you again for half the amount 2 seconds later.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.sig.stonegua: Gives Fire Resistance for 30 seconds and a 4 point ward for 20 seconds.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.sig.static_l: Staggers the target for 2 seconds. Foes within 4 blocks stagger for 1 second.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.sig.briar_sn: Roots foes within 3 blocks of the target for 3 seconds. The target bleeds.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.sig.tidal_pu: Foes within 4 blocks of the target are soaked and pushed away from you.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.sig.owls_gaz: Foes within 20 blocks glow for 10 seconds.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.sig.slimebou: Foes within 4 blocks are launched upward. You gain Resistance I for 10 seconds.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.sig.chainsto: Foes within 5 blocks of the spot are soaked and take half a strike.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.sig.riftwalk: Gives Speed II for 3 seconds. Foes within 4 blocks of your start are slowed 3 seconds.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.sig.phoenix_: Foes within 4 blocks burn for 5 seconds. You gain a 6 point ward for 20 seconds.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.sig.life_blo: Allies within 6 blocks gain Regeneration I for 10 seconds.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.sig.void_wel: Foes in the well are weakened for 8 seconds and lifted for 1 second.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.sig.wardens_: Foes in range gain Darkness and Weakness for 6 seconds.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.sig.aegis_of: Allies within 6 blocks gain Absorption I for 20 seconds.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.sig.wither_s: Wither spreads to foes within 4 blocks of the target for 6 seconds.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.sig.time_loc: Foes in the field freeze solid for 1 second.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.sig.dragonfa: Foes within 5 blocks of the spot are thrown up and burn for 6 seconds.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.sig.ice_lanc: Every struck foe becomes Brittle for 6 seconds.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.sig.soul_sip: Gives a 4 point ward for 10 seconds and Regeneration I for 5 seconds.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.sig.venom_da: Poison II spreads to foes within 4 blocks of the target for 6 seconds.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.sig.sapping_: Heals you 1 for each hexed foe. Gives Regeneration I for 5 seconds.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.sig.blinding: Foes within 5 blocks of the target are blinded for 4 seconds.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.sig.ember_br: Foes within 3 blocks of the target take half the hit and are Scorched 5 seconds.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.sig.haste_ru: Gives Haste IV and Speed I for 10 seconds.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.sig.shadow_v: Foes within 5 blocks are blinded for 3 seconds as you vanish.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.sig.sanctuar: Undead in the zone are staggered for 2 seconds and burn for 4.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.sig.purify.t: You and allies within 6 blocks gain Regeneration II for 5 seconds.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.sig.frost_no: Foes in the nova freeze solid for 1.5 seconds.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.sig.earthspi: Foes at the spot are rooted for 3 seconds.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.sig.plague_c: Foes in the cloud are weakened for 8 seconds.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.sig.flame_ri: The ring flares at once: foes in range take a full hit and are thrown back.
Foes in range take a hit of 2 damage and are slowed 4 seconds more.
